verdict.rationale: BILL's own v3 API docs say developers can use the Spend & Expense services to 'set up budgets, users, & virtual cards', and the S&E API is part of the public platform. This is a first-party programmatic card capability. Beyond that one line, the evidence shows no specific card endpoints and does not cover setting a limit at creation, locking a card, or updating card controls. Missing for 10: documented card-creation endpoint with spend limit, card lock/freeze endpoint, card-controls update endpoint, physical card issuance via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
